turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on polite requests?
turns.tutor:
Let me solve one first and think out loud: "Give me the bread."
Step 1: "Give me" can sound rude, so I take it away.
Step 2: I start with "Can I have".
Step 3: I add please at the end: "Can I have the bread, please?"
Rule: to ask nicely, use "Can I have" or "I would like", and add please.
Right: Can I have some juice, please? Wrong: Give me some juice.
Your turn. Write a polite sentence.
Make this polite: "Give me a coffee."
